summary: Attempt 4 is a test-hardening correction of the functionally approved task 12.3, addressing the two test-honesty gaps the independent test-quality-reviewer recorded (TQ-12.3-01 MEDIUM and TQ-12.3-03 LOW). No production source behaviour was changed: the only source-adjacent edits are none, and only tests plus current-state documentation changed. (1) TQ-12.3-01: the committed test named for the top-anchor status-pill reservation was non-failing because its narrow pills (about 44 px) never reached the opposite-side status pill, so removing the reservation left the suite green. A new 2-case theory, BadgeSizePositionTests.TopAnchorsReserveTheFirstRowForAWideStatusBand (TopLeft and TopRight), uses a wide probe (status 94 px, one technical pill 900 px on a 1000 px poster) so the reserved first row (952 - 94 - 8 = 850 px) cannot hold the technical pill; the test asserts the technical pill is placed below the status band, the two pills do not overlap, and both stay inside the scaled safe area. (2) TQ-12.3-03: the Center-anchor status-band row reduction was never exercised. A new fact, BadgeSizePositionTests.CenterAnchorStatusBandDropsTheRowsThatWouldStartInsideIt, uses a 1000x240 poster where two centered rows would start at y=68 inside the 80 px status band; the reduction drops the block to one row at y=96, so the test asserts exactly three technical pills, all in row 0 at y=96, clearing the status pill. Both new cases were proven non-vacuous on a throwaway copy: removing only the top-anchor reservation fails the reservation theory for TopLeft and TopRight (Failed 2, Passed 1, Total 3) while the Center fact still passes, and disabling only the Center reduction fails the Center fact (Expected 3, Actual 6; Failed 1, Passed 2, Total 3) while the reservation theory still passes. Count reconciliation: BadgeSizePositionTests 39 -> 42 cases, task 12.3 new cases 45 -> 48, full default suite Failed 0, Passed 1,490, Skipped 63, Total 1,553 -> Failed 0, Passed 1,493, Skipped 63, Total 1,556 (+48 over the unchanged pre-task baseline Failed 0, Passed 1,445, Skipped 63, Total 1,508), focused layout/renderer/configuration/page filter 142/2/144 -> 145/2/147, focused new-test filter 4/0/4 -> 7/0/7. The docs/changelog.md Task 12.3 entry, docs/project-status.md, and docs/limitations.md V6 were reconciled to the exact new counts; no stale current-state count remains. RendererConfiguration.CurrentSchemaVersion is still 1, RenderVersion.CurrentRendererVersion is still 2, and tests/ArrTags.Tests/Goldens/ is unmodified (task 12.4 owns the coordinated schema/RenderVersion advance and golden regeneration).

The two added cases strengthen the test suite's honesty; they do not add new production coverage beyond the existing reservation and Center-reduction branches.

The wide-probe reservation case uses a caller-supplied measure delegate (status 70 px text, technical 876 px text) rather than the shared TenPerCharacter delegate, because the real 24-scalar/10-px-per-character bound caps a technical pill at 264 px, which can never reach the opposite-side status pill on the reference poster. This is the same delegate-based measurement the engine exposes for testing and mirrors the reviewer's wide-pill probe; it is a deliberate probe of the reservation boundary, not a production rendering path.
